name: manual_4addc9
claim: The force-delete-branch git command is blocked by this workstation's dangerous-cmd-block hook even for branches independently verified as fully superseded — when cleanup is needed, write a standalone reviewable shell script to a location outside the hook-restricted session (e.g. OpenClaw/references/) rather than attempting the deletes inline.

decisions.notes: 2026-07-22: attempted the force-delete-branch command on a confirmed-safe branch during a 33-branch cleanup and was blocked. The correct pattern (used successfully) is generate-and-hand-off: produce a dry-run-tested script the user runs themselves outside the restricted session, rather than repeatedly retrying blocked commands.
